question: Mission Parivar Vikas was initially in the ______ high focus states.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7 high focus states**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• **Mission Parivar Vikas** was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in **2016** to address the high fertility rate in certain regions of India.

• The initiative was initially focused on **7 high focus states**, namely **Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, and Assam**.

• These states were identified due to their high Total Fertility Rate (TFR), which was significantly above the national average.

• The program aimed to accelerate access to family planning services and reduce the TFR to the replacement level of 2.
